operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 exceptional item of ₹8.99 Cr (FY26 ₹65.31 Cr) covers severance and retiral benefits at Pfaudler GmbH, Germany, with further releases proposed in the next financial year.
The group acquired 100% of SEMCO Tecnologia em Processos Ltda., Brazil for about ₹162 Cr and 51% of GMM Inox sp. z o.o. for ₹25.30 Cr, creating goodwill of ₹88.09 Cr in FY26.
The group completed the sale of its Hyderabad facility in Q4FY26 and recognised a gain of ₹7.23 Cr under other income.
German restructuring is expected to save ₹45 Cr annually.
